args.run_sh:
#!/bin/bash
#flux: --nodes 2
#flux: --exclusive
#flux: --output /x/run.out

export A=1
crit_ranks=$(flux getattr broker.critical-ranks)
crit_nodes=$(flux hostlist --nth="${crit_ranks}" local)
num_crit_nodes=$(flux hostlist --nth="${crit_ranks}" -c local)
num_nodes=$(flux hostlist -c local)
num_nodes=$((num_nodes - num_crit_nodes))
flux resource drain "${crit_ranks}"
flux run --nodes "$num_nodes" --exclusive hostname
echo BODY

expect.contains: flux exec -r all bash -c 'setsid nohup moirai-service start
